stemMd: Which day had the highest attendance rate among booked appointments?

options.label: D
options.textMd: All categories have the same rate

explanationMd: Compute the rates separately: Monday: 35/50=70%; Wednesday: 56/70=80%; Friday: 68/80=85%. Compare these proportions rather than raw successful counts. The highest rate is 85%.

distractorRationale.c: Compare each numerator with its own denominator. The rates are 70%, 80%, 85%; this claim does not identify all and only the highest-rate categories.
distractorRationale.b: Compare each numerator with its own denominator. The rates are 70%, 80%, 85%; this claim does not identify all and only the highest-rate categories.
distractorRationale.d: The ratios differ; equal rates cannot be inferred from the raw totals.
